name: booking
title: Booking
description: Book the whole house, or a room, in four steps built from every Wave 2 part: dates with the season ribbon, guests and room, your details with the phone confirmed by a code, and a signature to confirm and hold, with breakfast as a switch. A live quote from the booking kernels shows every band's nights, GST on its own line and the deposit, calls provisional figures provisional, and shows no figure for a single room the card does not price. The hold is stamped Held. A prototype that sends, holds and charges nothing, and says so; without JavaScript every step shows and the form validates and submits.
